proposal.thesis: Marvell used today's Investor Day to raise its fiscal 2028 revenue target to about $20B from the $18B it gave in August, above the roughly $18.2B consensus, and to lift its FY2029 custom-silicon target to more than $12B from more than $10B. The FY28 goal has been raised five times since December 2025, so sell-side models have lagged management all year and will have to chase again over the next few weeks. The stock is $289 live versus a $271.25 Monday close and still about 17.8% below its ~$330 52-week high, in a weekly uptrend with a fresh breakout above its 20-day high. The trade is the estimate-revision drift back toward the prior high, with a stop under the entire event move. KB-7057672046 set the stop beyond the named structural levels; KB-5969100993 set the size at 1% of equity over the stop distance.
catalysts: Sell-side estimate and target revisions after the 2026-10-06 Investor Day (next 1-3 weeks)
Hyperscaler capex commentary in late-October 2026 earnings season
Next MRVL print around 2026-12-01 (outside the 40-day horizon)
proposal.macro_context: Supportive tape: SPY ~$780 above its 50-DMA ($762.98) and 200-DMA ($717.56), momentum factor healthy, VIX ~$15. Rising 10-year yields (5.28%) are the main headwind for long-duration growth multiples, which is why the size is the normal 1% risk and not more.
proposal.risk_map: The main risk is a sell-the-news fade: the stock was up about 10% intraday and is now about +6.6%, and long-dated targets (FY2031) are easy to discount. Early warning is a close back below the $273.83 anchored VWAP of the breakout, then the $271.25 pre-event close; a close below $268 means the whole event move has failed and I am out. A second risk is a rate-driven de-rating of AI compute multiples (forward P/E ~43 on the bundle's estimate), which would show up as the group selling off together.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: 43 analysts rate MRVL strong_buy with a $293.88 mean target, about 2% above the live price, and pre-event FY2028 revenue consensus was about $18.2B. MY VIEW: the new ~$20B FY28 target and >$12B FY29 custom target push estimates and targets materially higher over the next few weeks, and the stock retests its ~$330 high. MECHANISM: sell-side models anchor to the last formal guide and have trailed management through five consecutive raises of the FY28 goal, so the stale $293.88 mean target is a lagging artifact of the August $18B outlook, not a ceiling. RESOLUTION: published estimate and target revisions over the next one to three weeks, and whether MRVL holds above $271.25 while they arrive.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: Any walk-back of the new ~$20B FY2028 target, a disclosed loss or delay of a hyperscaler custom program, or consensus FY2028 revenue failing to move up toward the new target within three weeks.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: A daily close below $268, which is under both the $271.25 pre-event close and the $273.83 breakout anchored VWAP, meaning the full Investor Day gap has filled.
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If MRVL has not made a daily close above $310 by 2026-10-27, cut or exit; hard horizon 40 days (2026-11-15), before the next print around 2026-12-01.
